diagnosis: The check C2 passed in all rollouts because the decision-maker chose 'project-key' for the cache_key_scope, which aligns with the PF1 fact that dictates the cache-key scope should be tenant-scoped when two tenants share a project slug. This led to the creation of the cache_isolation commitment, satisfying check C2 even though the decision-maker did not have access to PF1.

C2.why: The two tenants sharing a project slug changes the cache-key choice from the default unscoped policy to tenant_scoped, requires the isolation test, and creates the cache_isolation commitment.
